The '''1967–68 Scottish Division One''' was won by [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]] by two points over city rivals [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]]. [[Motherwell F.C.|Motherwell]] and [[Stirling Albion F.C.|Stirling Albion]] finished 17th and 18th respectively and were relegated to the [[1968–69 Scottish Division Two|1968-69 Second Division]].
